physics_goals.quote: The DMRadio program consists of a series of experiments designed to probe low mass axions.
physics_goals.value: Search for low-mass QCD axion dark matter (peV-ueV range) using lumped-element LC-resonator haloscopes rather than microwave cavities

summary.plain: DMRadio is a series of experiments at Stanford and SLAC that search for very light dark-matter axions using a magnet and a tuned electrical circuit instead of a microwave cavity. It is currently being built.
summary.technical: Lumped-element LC-resonator axion haloscope program: DMRadio-50L (1 T toroidal magnet, 5 kHz-5 MHz, Stanford campus) and DMRadio-m3 (4 T solenoidal magnet, 30-200 MHz, SLAC); under construction/commissioning per the October 2022 status paper (arXiv:2210.07215) and a July 2026 paper (arXiv:2607.05771).
